title: Sticker Studio for WhatsApp
description: *Sticker Studio* is a **web tool that turns a photo or a video into a WhatsApp sticker**: it cuts out the background, frames and colours the picture, adds captions, and merges pictures into an animation. A video becomes an animated sticker: pick the clip, and the tool samples it into frames.

Browsers can only encode one still picture, so I **wrote the animated WebP writer myself**, packing frames into the container rather than compressing them. The background is found by colour from the frame edges, with no model.
Stickers are checked against **WhatsApp's own validator source**, which differs from its written guide on four rules. The pixel work is **test-covered**, and nothing leaves the device.
